Overview

Connect your images to one Offsetizo node and they fill a grid in the order of their inputs. Rows and Columns set how many show, spacing and alignment arrange them, and Grid Center places the whole grid.

Turn on Animate and keyframe Element 1's Offset, Scale, Rotation or Opacity. Every other image plays the same move a few frames after the one before and lands in its own place. Any image can wait longer or sit the animation out, and Motion Blur smooths the movement.

Requirements

Software
DaVinci Resolve Free or Studio on the Fusion page, or Fusion Studio. Tested on Resolve 21.1.x
Operating system
Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit; macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon (Resolve 21.1's minimum)
License
None: no key, no activation and no account
Download
One ZIP for Windows or macOS with the Studio installer and Offsetizo.fuse

Questions about your setup? Ask in the Clipyx Discord or send us a message.

Key features

  • Up to 32 image inputs in one node. Images fill the grid in input order, and empty inputs leave no gap.
  • Layout: Rows and Columns, horizontal and vertical spacing, rows first or columns first, alignment, Grid Center, Per-Element Offset for cascades, and Unify Size to give every image the first one's visible size, whatever the files' resolutions.
  • Follow animation: with Animate on, the other images replay Element 1's keyframed Offset, Scale, Rotation and Opacity, each Delay frames later.
  • Stagger your way: by image, row or column, first to last, last to first, from both ends to the middle or from the middle out, with the second half coming in from the opposite side if you like.
  • Per image: its own Offset, Scale, Rotation, Opacity and Extra Delay, or leave it out of the animation.
  • Transform page: Center, Pivot, Size, Angle and Opacity for the whole layout, and Motion Blur with Quality, Shutter Angle and Center Bias.
  • Free download, no key.

Best for

  • Logo and icon walls
  • Photo grids and collages
  • Staggered reveals
  • Split screens
  • Product and screenshot showcases
  • Grids of video clips
Setup & help guide for Offsetizo Install, find it in Resolve, the controls, common problems, uninstall

Offsetizo v1.2, the grid and offset animation Fuse.

Install
  1. Extract the complete ZIP before installing, and read legal/CLIPIZO_PRODUCT_LICENSE.txt.
  2. Resolve Studio / Fusion Studio: drag Offsetizo studio installer.lua into the Nodes area of the Fusion page. The result appears in the Console. Then restart.
  3. Resolve Free (works in Studio too): close Resolve and copy Offsetizo.fuse into your user Fuses folder, creating it if needed. Resolve Free doesn't run the Studio installer.
  4. Windows user Fuses folder: %APPDATA%\Blackmagic Design\DaVinci Resolve\Support\Fusion\Fuses
  5. macOS user Fuses folder: ~/Library/Application Support/Blackmagic Design/DaVinci Resolve/Fusion/Fuses/
  6. Keep one copy of Offsetizo in your Fuses folders, and restart Resolve after installing or updating.
Where it appears in Resolve

On the Fusion page, press Shift+Space and type Offsetizo or its shortcut, Offset. In the Effects Library it is under Clipyx.

Connect up to 32 images to its inputs, and its output to MediaOut1 or a Merge.

Controls in plain words

Some controls appear only after choosing the relevant mode.

Layout
YouTube / Clipyx Store
Open the Clipyx channel and the store in your browser.
Scale
The size of every image.
Rows / Columns
How many images show: Rows × Columns. The sliders go to 6; type up to 32. Images beyond that don't show.
Horizontal Spacing / Vertical Spacing
The gaps between images.
Grid Center
Where the whole grid sits.
Per-Element Offset
Shifts each image a little further than the one before, for cascades and diagonals.
Unify Size
Scales every image so its visible content is the same size in pixels as the first one's, whatever the files' resolutions.
Layout Direction
Horizontal First fills rows first; Vertical First fills columns first.
Horizontal Align / Vertical Align
Left, Center or Right, and Top, Middle or Bottom.
Rotation
Turns every image in its place.
Image
Auto Resolution uses the composition's frame size; turn it off to type a Width and Height. Reconnect redraws input wires that don't show after pasting.
Animation
Animate
Off by default. When it is on, the other images replay Element 1's keyframed Offset, Scale, Rotation and Opacity.
Delay
The frames between one image's start and the next.
Stagger By
Elements, Rows or Columns: what moves together. With Rows or Columns, a whole row or column starts at once.
Order
First to Last, Last to First, Ends to Middle (the first and last start together and meet in the middle) or Middle to Ends.
Second Half From Opposite Side
The second half comes in from the other side.
Help
Shows a short guide on the Animation page.
Element groups
Each image's own Offset, Scale, Rotation, Opacity and Extra Delay, and Exclude From Follower Animations. A value that isn't keyframed on Element 1 changes only Element 1.
Refresh List
Updates the list of which image is on which input.
Transform
Center / Pivot / Size / Angle
Moves, scales and turns the whole layout.
Opacity
Fades the whole layout.
Motion Blur
Off by default. Quality, Shutter Angle and Center Bias set how it blurs Offsetizo's own movement; the images coming in are used as they are.
Common problems
Not in the tool search
Extract the ZIP, check that the file still ends in .fuse, and restart Resolve after copying it. Use the user Fuses location for a manual install. Avoid installing a second copy of the same tool.
An older interface still appears
Resolve caches Fuse code. Fully restart it, then try a newly added node; an existing node may retain saved values.
An image doesn't show
Rows × Columns sets how many images show. Raise Rows or Columns.
Element groups are missing
Click Refresh List on the Animation page.
Motion blur is slow
Each frame is rendered several times, more with a higher Quality. Turn it off while editing.
A Mac blocks the downloaded file
Use System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway.
Uninstall
  1. Close Resolve / Fusion. Move only Offsetizo.fuse out of the Fuses folder where you installed it, to a backup folder outside the Fusion search folders.
  2. If you used the Studio installer, check the destination it reported (which can be the shared Clipyx/Fuses folder). Leave other Clipyx files in place.
  3. Restart the application. Existing projects using this tool will need it reinstalled to render the same result.

Still stuck? Contact Clipyx with the plugin version, Resolve version, operating system and the exact error message.

Updates log

v1.2 Released 7 Nov 2026

Offsetizo v1.2 fixes how it looks at reduced playback resolution, as a user reported. Download it again to get it.

Bug fixes

  • Layouts now look the same at half and quarter playback resolution. Before, images came out at half or quarter size. Final renders were never affected.
v1.1 Released 4 Nov 2026

Offsetizo v1.1 adds new ways to stagger the animation, all asked for by users, and fixes Unify Size. The new settings start out as v1.0 behaved, so your comps look the same. Download it again to get it.

What's new in 1.1

  • Stagger By: Elements, Rows or Columns, so whole rows or columns can move together.
  • Order: First to Last, Last to First, Ends to Middle (the first and last start together and meet in the middle) or Middle to Ends.
  • Second Half From Opposite Side brings the second half in from the other side.
  • A Help checkbox on the Animation page shows a short guide.

Bug fixes

  • Unify Size now gives every image the same visible size in pixels as the first one, whatever the files' resolutions. Before, a bigger file stayed bigger and could even grow.
